summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/blank. Core-shell passes 'platform', billing 'payments', and reports 'insights' (reports also calls validateApp, so it would have broken at startup). Assumptions: shared-contracts is in-repo and inlined at build, so no registry release or dependency bump was needed (CONTRIBUTING); owner values hardcoded from each package.json team, since bundles can't read package.json. All three apps built locally; CI and CD green on PR #1.
